paragraphs: I test software where correctness matters most: online banking and digital payments. At Cognizant in Canada I design risk-based test scenarios for account management, fund transfers and loan servicing, and validate critical banking workflows before release.

My automation work uses Selenium WebDriver with Python, PyTest and the Page Object Model, run in Azure DevOps pipelines. It has reached approximately 35% automation coverage at Cognizant. It also contributed to an estimated 20% reduction in recurring defects through improved regression coverage.

Before that, at Paytm, I tested UPI transactions, wallet operations and payment status updates. I traced failed payments across dependent services and raised payment regression automation coverage by approximately 30%.

I also evaluate AI-assisted test case generation. Reviewing generated scenarios against business requirements and edge cases cut initial drafting effort by an estimated 25% where the workflow was applicable. I hold a Masters in Quality Systems from Concordia University.
